purpose: Teach: 異端/卑怯/束縛/醜い/人為/援護/邪悪/監獄

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、業界の異端者として尖った商品を出せ
lines.en: I want this company to be an outlier in our industry—to make products that cut through the noise.
lines.style: Measured and direct. Slight pause after the dash to let the vision land. Firm but not barking. The tone of someone who has decided what matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。卑怯な競合の妨害には毅然と対応します
lines.en: Understood. We'll stand firm against any underhanded tactics from competitors.
lines.style: Steady, professional confirmation. The word 'firm' carries a small note of commitment. Even tempo, no hesitation. The voice of someone taking an oath seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員を契約で過度に束縛するな
lines.en: And don't lock our people down with excessive contract terms.
lines.style: Shift to something more measured and almost protective. The 'don't' is firm but not sharp—it's a principle, not a command. Slight exhale, like he's clarifying something important.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品の見た目が醜いと評されぬよう注意します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure our products are something the team can take pride in.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. A touch warmer than before—this one connects to people, not just systems. Even pacing. The slight emphasis on 'pride' shows he's understood the human side.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人為ミスを防ぐ自動化を進めろ
lines.en: Push forward on automation that prevents human error.
lines.style: Direct and forward-looking. A slight acceleration on 'automation'—the word carries energy. Confident but not arrogant. The tone of someone who trusts the solution.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。困っている社員を援護する制度を作ります
lines.en: Understood. I'll build systems to support the team when they're struggling.
lines.style: Warm confirmation. The words 'build systems' are deliberate—he's understood this is about care, not just compliance. Slight softening on 'struggling,' like he sees the people behind the process.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、邪悪な情報操作には絶対に手を染めるな
lines.en: Never, under any circumstance, let this company get drawn into information manipulation.
lines.style: Absolute and uncompromising. The opening word lands with weight. Slight pause before 'never' to emphasize finality. This is a line in the sand—his voice is steady, not angry, but immovable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員が監獄に入る事のないよう法令遵守を徹底します
lines.en: Understood. I'll ensure we maintain strict legal and ethical compliance so our team never finds themselves in legal jeopardy.
lines.style: Final affirmation with gravity. The phrase 'never finds themselves' slows slightly—he's taking full responsibility. Professional but personal. The closer to the conversation carries a note of solemn promise.
